usage: agentware tick [-h] [--format {text,json}] [--install-schedule]
                      [--uninstall-schedule] [--lock-status]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --install-schedule    install the shared tick into HOME (launchd
                        StartInterval=1800 / cron */30) — refuses when no job
                        is enabled
  --uninstall-schedule  remove an installed tick schedule (idempotent; leaves
                        dream alone)
  --lock-status         print the updater/tick lock state (free|held|stale)
                        and exit (read-only; used by the loop reverse-guard)
